description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744385

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics -Consultant — Collibra Data Intelligence Platform-GIG**

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with deep, hands-on expertise in the **Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** to lead the design, implementation and adoption of data governance capabilities across the enterprise. You will work directly with data owners, stewards, architects and business stakeholders to translate governance policy into a working Collibra implementation — operating model, metadata, lineage, workflows and data quality — and make it something the business actually uses.

This is a hands-on delivery role with strong client and stakeholder exposure. You will be equally comfortable configuring the platform and standing in front of a steering committee explaining why it matters.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and configuration of the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, including operating model design, communities, domains, asset types, relations, complex attributes and scopes.
* Design and build **Collibra workflows** (BPMN / Groovy) for data steward approvals, issue management, access requests and onboarding processes.
* Configure and manage the **Collibra Data Catalog**, business glossary, reference data and policy management modules.
* Implement technical and business lineage using **Collibra Lineage Harvester, Edge** and custom lineage ingestion.
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise source systems, data platforms and BI tools using the Collibra REST APIs, Edge connectors, Catalog connectors and JDBC ingestion.
* Define and operationalise data governance frameworks: roles and responsibilities, stewardship models, data ownership, policies and standards.
* Establish metadata ingestion pipelines and automate bulk metadata onboarding via APIs and import templates.
* Define and track data quality rules, KPIs and dashboards; support remediation of data quality issues with the relevant data owners.
* Support platform administration: user and group management, roles and permissions, environment promotion and release management.
* Run workshops, training and enablement sessions for stewards and business users to drive platform adoption.
* Produce solution design documents, configuration guides, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Provide advisory input on governance roadmap, maturity assessments and best practice to senior stakeholders.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **8+ years** of overall experience in data management, data governance or enterprise data platforms.
* **Proven, hands-on proficiency with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** — not just usage, but design and configuration across multiple implementations.
* Strong command of the Collibra operating model: asset types, domains, communities, attributes, relations, hierarchies and validation rules.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting Collibra workflows (BPMN, Groovy scripting).
* Experience with Collibra Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Helpdesk and Policy Manager.
* Working knowledge of Collibra Edge, Lineage Harvester and connector-based metadata ingestion.
* Solid experience with the Collibra REST API for automation, bulk operations and system integration.
* Strong SQL and a good understanding of data modelling, metadata management and data architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data privacy and regulatory drivers (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, CCPA).
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and written communication skills — able to work with both engineering teams and business leadership.
* Linux skills to manage the on-premise server components

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Collibra Data Quality (DQ)** — rule authoring, DQ job configuration, scorecards, and integration of DQ results back into the Collibra Data Catalog.
* **Python** — for API automation, metadata ingestion scripts and data quality validation.
* **Git** — version control for workflow artefacts, scripts and configuration-as-code; familiarity with branching strategies and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Snowflake** — cataloguing and lineage from Snowflake
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) and modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks).
* Experience with other governance or DQ tools (Informatica, Alation, Ataccama, Great Expectations) for comparative context.
* API Development with Spring Boot
* Consulting background with experience running client-facing engagements and pre-sales support.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
* **Collibra Ranger / Collibra Expert certification** strongly preferred (e.g. Collibra Certified Ranger, Data Steward, or Workflow Developer).

Certifications in Snowflake, cloud platforms or DAMA CDMP are an advantage.

  

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

description:

* Select appropriate architectural patterns across Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Power BI, Real-Time Intelligence, Data Science, and Azure services.

* Define identity, access, networking, encryption, privacy, retention, audit, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity requirements.
* Create migration strategies and roadmaps for legacy warehouses, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Power BI, and on-premises platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, design authorities, technical risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews.
* Provide oversight across multiple delivery teams and ensure adherence to architectural standards.
* Lead technical proposals, estimations, solution presentations, proofs of concept, and client workshops.

* Mentor senior engineers and architects and develop organizational Fabric capability.
* Remain accountable for technical outcomes, platform quality, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

**Mandatory technical skills**

* Extensive experience architecting enterprise cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure data services and Microsoft Fabric architecture.
* Strong knowledge of OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Spark, Delta Lake, Power BI, and real-time processing.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, data mesh, data products, dimensional modeling, and metadata management.
* Expertise in security architecture, Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, private networking, secrets management, and regulatory controls.
* Experience designing CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, environment strategy, observability, and operational-support models.
* Proven capability in capacity planning, performance engineering, cost management, and workload optimization.
* Experience leading large migration or modernization programmes.
* Strong stakeholder communication, technical governance, estimation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to compare technology options and clearly communicate architectural trade-offs.

**Preferred skills**

* Experience implementing Microsoft Purview and enterprise data-governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI/ML, Azure AI services, Fabric Data Science, and AI-ready data architecture.
* Experience across regulated industries or large global enterprises.
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or comparable certification.

Pre-sales, consulting, proposal development, or solution-estimation experience
